text:
Recent work supports separating durable preference from transient intent. [Mamba4Rec (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03900) offers selective state-space sequence modeling with efficient inference. [M2Rec (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.04445) adds FFT periodicity modeling and learned fusion, but its pretrained LLM embeddings fall outside this task’s constraints. The closest architectural match is [DSRec (September 2026 preprint)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.21548): separate long-term historical-interest and short-term session branches, distinct SSM encoders, temporal-gap modulation, and residual cross-fusion. These mechanisms model changing interests; they do not establish that purchases indicate completed needs.

For repeat timing, [SLH-BIA (SIGIR 2024; Target’s 2025 technical account)](https://tech.target.com/blog/buy-it-again-part-2) combines exponential and Gaussian Hawkes kernels to capture immediate recurrence and delayed replenishment. This supplies a useful alternative to monotonically decaying recency. However, its self-excitation mechanism is not explicit purchase inhibition, and its item/category repurchase setting differs from unseen-item recommendation. Here, transfer the timing idea to learned interest states; product-category metadata is unavailable.

A lightweight hypothesis suggested by these results: maintain several causal intent states with learned slow/fast decay, timestamp-gap updates, and a candidate-dependent gate; add a temporary suppression state after interactions with similar items. Treat suppression as a hypothesis, since histories alone do not reveal task completion. Compare against SASRec, the fixed recent-history residual, slow-state-only, fast-state-only, and suppression-disabled variants. Shuffle historical gaps to test timing dependence; mask older recurring interests to test their contribution. Evaluate validation HR@10 separately for recurring-interest and recent-interest-shift histories, while retaining the required four-category macro HR@10 for selection. Use prefix-only inputs and no unknown next-event timestamp.
